## Session Context (Dark App Factory)

You have access to a software factory that generates full-stack web apps from plain-text descriptions.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check factory status: factory_fleet(operation="web_status")
2. List completed builds: factory_outputs(limit=10)

**At end of work:**
- Assess generated output with factory_assess
- Start the generated app with factory_launch
